opportunities.name: Unbroken harvest frontliner
opportunities.objective: Test unbroken harvest frontliner against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Bountiful Harvest heals for damage dealt and refunds 60% remaining cooldown only when its two-second channel finishes. Aftershock from fear buys a short resistance window; Visage and Riftmaker support draining while Liandry supplies magic pressure.
opportunities.requiredState: Fear or silence available to protect the entire channel.
opportunities.failure: A single interruption loses final missing-health damage and the refund.
opportunities.test: Compare complete and interrupted channels, recording healing and next-W timing.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Durability does not make the channel unstoppable.

opportunities.name: Effigy lane ambush cadence
opportunities.objective: Test effigy lane ambush cadence against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Terrify's passive activates from unseen/out-of-combat or effigy impersonation; stationary setup plus distant Reap can start First Strike before Crowstorm. Malignance supports ultimate magic damage and haste, while Horizon reveals the long-range opening target.
opportunities.requiredState: Hide or impersonate for two seconds and establish the first damage packet.
opportunities.failure: Enemy vision or incidental damage removes the planned fear and First Strike.
opportunities.test: Test seen versus unseen E-to-R entries and record fear separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Effigies do not deal substitute champion damage or create unlimited fears.

ruledOut.reason: Durability does not make the channel unstoppable.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.name: Unbroken harvest frontliner
builds.summary: Test unbroken harvest frontliner against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test unbroken harvest frontliner against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Bountiful Harvest heals for damage dealt and refunds 60% remaining cooldown only when its two-second channel finishes. Aftershock from fear buys a short resistance window; Visage and Riftmaker support draining while Liandry supplies magic pressure.
testPlan: Required state: Fear or silence available to protect the entire channel.
Compare complete and interrupted channels, recording healing and next-W timing.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A single interruption loses final missing-health damage and the refund.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Durability does not make the channel unstoppable.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Void Staff, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus [12 / 14.5 / 17 / 19.5 / 22]% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores [25 / 32.5 / 40 / 47.5 / 55]% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.

Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for [1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2] second(s).

Active: Fear an enemy for [1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2] second(s) and deal [0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 + (0.0003) × AP] current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal [(0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 + (0.0003) × AP) × (2)] current Health magic damage.
Fiddlesticks channels for [1.5] seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP) × (5)] magic damage over [5] seconds.

Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [(-0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4 / -0.45 / -0.5) × -100]% for [1.25] seconds. Enemies in the center are also Silenced for the duration.
